subject: general
question: Under whose administration is the Department of Atomic Energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prime Minister's Office.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) came into being on **August 3, 1954.**
 
• It came under the direct charge of the Prime Minister through a Presidential Order
 
• The Secretary to the Government of India in the Department of Atomic Energy is ex-officio Chairman of the Atomic Energy Commission.
 
• DAE has been engaged in the development of
 
 
• **nuclear power technology**
 
• **applications of radiation technologies in the fields of agriculture**
 
• **medicine**
 
• **industry **
 
 
 
• Its vision is to empower India through technology, creation of more wealth and providing better quality of life to its citizen. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Organizations under DAE**

 

 
• **Power Sector**

 
 
• Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd., Mumbai
 
• Bharatiya Nabhikiya Vidyut Nigam Ltd., Kalpakkam
 
 
 
• **Research and Development Centres**
 
 
• Bhabha Atomic Research Centre, Mumbai
 
• Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research, Kalpakkam
 
• Raja Ramanna Centre for Advanced Technology, Indore
 
 
 
• **Industrial Organisations**
 
 
• Nuclear Fuel Complex, Hyderabad
 
• Heavy Water Board, Mumbai
 
• Board of Radiation and Isotope Technology, Mumbai
 
 
 
• **Public Sector Units**
 
 
• Uranium Corporation of India Ltd., Jaduguda
 
• Electronics Corporation of India Ltd., Hyderabad
 
• Indian Rare Earths Limited, Mumbai
